environment.description: ECS Fargate service running with task role 'ws-service-role' that has broad DynamoDB permissions: dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:PutItem on resource arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/*. No IAM condition keys restrict access. ALB forwards X-User-ID and X-Tenant-ID from JWT claims but the application does not enforce tenant boundaries at the data layer. DynamoDB tables use 'pk' as partition key with format 'TENANT#<id>#ENTITY#<id>' but nothing prevents cross-tenant key specification.

config.network: ALB -> ECS Fargate, public WebSocket endpoint
config.table_schema: pk (S) partition key, no sort key, no VPC endpoint policy
